Brief case of the prosecution is as under :

It is alleged in the chargesheet that on 16.05.2012, at about 6.30 a.m. when CW-1 was on beat duty, he received information that gas cylinders are being transported illegally and on the basis of said information he conducted raid at about 6.30 a.m.,
near Hegganahali, Sanjevininagar, Omshakthi Temple, and found that in a luggage vehicle bearing No.KA-53 A-1609 accused Nos.2 and 3 were transporting the Gas cylinders without having license  3 C.C.No.16223/2013 or permit to transport the same and thereby committed the offences U/s 3 and 7 E.C.Act and 420 r/w 34 of I.P.C.

After the completion of the investigation, the charge-sheet was submitted against the accused Nos.1 to 3 for the aforementioned offences.

5. In pursuance of the summons accused appeared and they are on Court bail.
The prosecution papers were supplied to accused No.1 as required U/s. 207 of Cr.P.C.
After hearing, the charge is framed  4 C.C.No.16223/2013 against the accused, to which he pleaded not guilty and claims to be tried.

sentences.text: 3 Point No.1: In the Negative.

Point No.2: As per final order for the following :
REASONS 10. Point No.1 : It is the case of prosecution that accused Nos.1 and 2 were transporting gas cylinder on the direction of accused No.1 illegally without having any license or permit and thereby accused Nos.1 to 3 have commited the offences U/s 3 and 7 E.C.Act and 420 r/w 34 of I.P.C.
11.
Prosecution to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 has adduced the evidence of PW-1 who is I.O., and he deposed before the court regarding conducting of investigation done by him.
During the cross-examination he denied the material suggestions of Ld.counsel for accused.
Admittedly, the complainant/cw-1 who is material witnesses did not turn up for evidence and other material witnesses ie., mahazar witnesses and eye-witnesses also remained absent.
So, in the absence of evidence of complainant and other material witnesses, the evidence of I.O., cannot be taken into consideration.
Therefore, this court is of the opinion, prosecution not proved the guilt of accused beyond all reasonable doubt.
Hence, I answer this Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. Point No.2 :
In view of the discussion made above, accused No.1 found not guilty.

Hence, I proceed to pass the following :
O R DE R Acting under section 248(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused No.1 is hereby acquitted for the offences punishable U/s 3 and 7 E.C.Act and 420 r/w 34 of I.P.C.
The bail bonds executed by accused Nos.1 and his surety shall stand cancelled subject to executing necessary bond U/s 437(A) of Cr.P.C., for Rs.25,000/-.
Entire case file and properties of this case shall be kept in Split-up CC.No.11143/2023, dated 13.04.2023, which is registered against accused Nos.2 and 3.
(Dictated to the Stenographer, transcript computerized by him, revised, corrected and pronounced by me in the open Court on this 17th day of January, 2024).
